title: driverWorkerQueue
responsibility: Read live worker task suffixes by slot cursor, preserving retryable future failures and skipping completed passes.

inputs.name: driverWorkerQueue.root
inputs.description: Driver collection root used to resolve slot task and result paths and scope live process discovery. Only code_task slot processes belonging to this root contribute model capacity.

inputs.name: driverWorkerQueue.state
inputs.description: Active driver snapshot to render. Adapter render defaults to a fresh read; dead PIDs are filtered by active(), not by the formatter.

inputs.name: driverWorkerQueue.processes
inputs.description: Defaults to undefined, selecting live code_task processes scoped to the supplied driver root.

outputs.name: driverWorkerQueue
outputs.description: Queued task suffixes and observed model slot counts, excluding active tasks and completed passes while retaining future retryable failures.
